symptom: approved own work that had visible defects
cause: self-review is lenient and generalizes from a sample
rule: review with the scorecard and a hostile pass; record 3 defects or exactly what was checked

symptom: said 'looks good' with nothing to point to
rule: every score needs a specific observation with a locator such as a timestamp, region or line

symptom: missed a defect between the frames viewed
rule: view frames at regular intervals plus every cut, the first and the last; say which were viewed

symptom: missed small errors in text, hands or edges
cause: looked at the whole picture only
rule: zoom into text, hands, faces, props and edges, and compare consecutive frames for sudden changes

symptom: agent kept passing work the user rejected
rule: log each user verdict with calibrate.py and read the report weekly; tighten the bar where false passes occur

symptom: standard quietly dropped to finish the task
rule: never lower the bar silently; if the bar seems wrong, tell the user and propose a new one

symptom: blocked on a matter of taste
cause: did not separate taste from defects
rule: mark taste items as optional notes; block only on objective defects against the request

symptom: confident verdict on something not fully seen
cause: hid the limits of the review
rule: state what could not be viewed or measured and ask the user to check those items

symptom: could not tell whether v2 was better
cause: no side-by-side on the same dimensions
rule: compare versions or a reference on identical dimensions and state better, worse or equal with reasons

cause: did not re-read the original request
rule: re-read the original request and acceptance criteria before judging, not your own plan
